items.title: Kane ends England’s 25-year wait to win men’s Ballon d’Or award
items.summary: Harry Kane becomes the first English player to win the prize since Michael Owen in 2001, and Spain midfielder Alexia Putellas wins the Ballon d’Or Feminin for a record-equalling third time.
